newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold down on unit's poor listing price.
newsitem.headline: Randgold down on unit's poor listing price.

text.p: Shares in South African mining house Randgold & Exploration Ltd tumbled on Thursday on disappointment following a much lower-than-expected listing price set for its resources unit which is to debut in London later on Thursday.
By noon Randgold was down 300 cents or 11.5 percent to 23.00 rand, a fresh 1997 low. Volumes were fairly light with some 46,300 shares traded.
"It's (down) on the listing price. It's much less than the market was expecting. It was looking for at least $18 or $19," a dealer at the Johannesburg Stock Exchange said.

It was announced earlier that shares in Randgold Resources Ltd, which will begin trading at 1330 GMT on the London Stock Exchange, were priced at $16.50 per share -- lower than the $18 to $23 range expected originally by Randgold chairman Peter Flack.
The float was intended to raise capital for Randgold Resources to help fund existing projects, such as the Syama gold mine and Loulo project in Mali.
